Interface GameInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
Game
public interface GameInterface extends Serializable
Represents the core interface for the Galaxy Trucker game logic. It exposes all key game methods for managing players, ship creation, tile drawing, card handling, and state transitions.
